verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents voicemail transcription or delivery of voicemails to email or chat for RingCentral. The only voicemail mention is generic 'visual voicemail' and managing voicemails on any device, which is an adjacent in-app feature rather than transcription delivered to email or chat. The voicemail-to-email comment refers to Voipfone, a competitor, so it does not count for RingCentral.

support.subject: As a founder, voicemails are transcribed and delivered to email or chat so I can read them without dialing in
